card.name: Linking words before historical era names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, Art) or a gap just before a named historical period, event or movement, in history passages about early 20th-century or earlier times.

modes.label: Before a named event
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'of' comes right before a famous historical event or institution.
modes.example: The Great Crash<< of>> '29 undermined confidence in the inevitable

modes.label: Before a decade or era
modes.description: A linking word or space comes before a decade such as the 1930s or 'late 1920s'.

modes.label: Before a movement or group name
modes.description: A word comes just before an art movement or group name.

card.writes: It pushes toward era words such as 'century' and away from 'late' and 'early', which suits a period name coming next.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a historical era, event or movement is named.
